jobs.title: Water Wastewater Project Engineer / Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Summit Engineering, Inc. is seeking a highly motivated Water Wastewater Project Engineer or Geologist with Hydrogeology experience to join our dynamic team. This role is focused on groundwater supply, water availability, and water adequacy evaluations for water supply systems and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have experience evaluating whether existing or proposed groundwater sources can reliably meet current and future water demands, including review of well records, aquifer testing, pumping data, modeling, seasonal groundwater trends, water quality and applicable County or regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate is self\-directed, technically strong and capable of managing complex hydrogeologic and engineering tasks while contributing to client relationships and business development.

Onsite (Santa Rosa) or Remote (depending upon experience)

**Salary Range:** $95,000 to $160,000 annually

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Hydrogeology \& Water Resources Experience**

* Plan, facilitate and execute groundwater investigations, including desktop studies, aquifer testing data interpretation
* Design, oversee and analyze aquifer tests (pumping, step\-drawdown, slug tests) to estimate aquifer parameters
* Evaluate site geology and regional geologic setting to understand how subsurface conditions may influence groundwater occurrence, aquifer behavior, recharge potential, storage, flow direction, water quality, well performance, and project feasibility
* Prepare and support groundwater source adequacy, water availability, and well capacity evaluations for development projects
* Review and interpret well completion reports, driller’s logs, geologic maps, boring logs, pump test data, static and pumping water levels, well production records, and available local groundwater data
* Develop or review water demand estimates and compare existing/proposed demands to available water supply data
* Plan, oversee, and interpret aquifer and well performance testing, including pumping tests, step\-drawdown tests, slug tests, and water level monitoring
* Evaluate seasonal reliability, dry\-year performance, well interference potential, and limitations of existing or proposed groundwater sources
* Analyze hydrogeologic data using appropriate tools, including conceptual hydrogeologic models and, where applicable, numerical groundwater modeling
* Prepare technical memoranda, water availability evaluations, and client and agency\-facing summaries that clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommended next steps
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies, well drillers, pump contractors, laboratories, and design teams as needed
* Analyze hydrogeologic data using appropriate tools
* Collect groundwater quality samples, coordinate lab analysis and interpret geochemical data
* Support conceptual and numerical groundwater modeling

**Engineering \& Project Delivery**

* Develop fee and time estimates for proposal preparation
* Communicate project status and updates to Project Managers
* Identify scope changes and alert Project Managers accordingly
* Prepare engineering analysis, calculations, and designs for assigned project components
* Produce construction documents with minimal oversight
* Manage task assignments to meet project budget and timelines
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance
* Stay current with industry codes and standards
* Respond to RFIs, review submittals and perform site visits
* Collaborate with clients and consultants for data collection and coordination
* Act as a technical lead on multi\-disciplinary tasks as needed

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Civil/Environmental Engineering or related field
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in the field of hydrogeology, groundwater resources, or environmental consulting
* California Professional Engineer (PE) license or Professional Geologist (PG) preferred or in the process of obtaining
* Familiarity with multiple hydrogeologic settings (unconsolidated, consolidated and bedrock aquifers)
* Experience with groundwater modeling software (e.g. MODFLOW, SWMM or similar tools)
* Proficiency in engineering and design software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Bluebeam
* Strong communication, organization, time management and problem\-solving skills with the ability to support multiple projects
* Understanding of applicable codes, permitting processes, and engineering design principles
* Must maintain a valid Driver’s License
* Eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship

Summit Engineering, Inc. is a multi\-disciplined design engineering firm located in the heart of beautiful Sonoma County, in Santa Rosa, CA. Our Civil, Wastewater, Structural and Electrical engineering and Planning divisions provide consulting services for wineries, high\-end residential properties, resorts, and other private sector projects. Summit Engineering has been voted as a “Best Places to Work” for twenty years. We work a 9/80 schedule, which means you have every other Friday off. Employees also have the option to work from home one day a week after their 90\-day introductory period.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Research Data Analyst 1
jobs.description:
WORK SCHEDULE:
Hybrid work arrangement with at least 4 days per week on\-site.  

  

BUDGETED SALARY:
The expected pay range for this position is $85,926 to $104,477 per annum.  

SCHOOL/UNIT DESCRIPTION:
Stanford University’s Center on Food Security and the Environment (FSE) addresses critical global issues of hunger, poverty and environmental degradation. Our long\-term goals focus on designing new approaches to solving food security’s global challenges by building an evolving research portfolio with a team of experts in relevant scientific, economic, and policy areas. FSE is a joint effort of the Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies and the Stanford Woods Institute for the Environment.  

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Center on Food Security and the Environment (FSE) is seeking a research data analyst (RDA) to contribute to several research projects that combine new data sources and computational tools to study climate impacts on agriculture and food security working with Professor Jen Burney. The RDA will help with identifying, assembling, and geo\-coding datasets on farm and household characteristics, agricultural systems, and environmental outcomes around the world. They will also participate in lab meetings of the Burney and Lobell Groups.  

This recruitment is for a one (1\) year fixed\-term, 100% FTE benefits\-eligible position which begins on the start date and may be renewable in the future based on funding availability.  

For consideration, please submit resume and cover letter. All final candidates must successfully complete a background check.  

PREFERRED/DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
The position will require a very organized and creative person who can write efficient code and work with large datasets, and who is interested in both the physical (natural) and social (human) sides of local, regional, and global food systems. Must have exceptional mathematical and statistical modeling and computer programming skills and willingness to use them in an innovative manner. Must have the ability to work comfortably and effectively within an interdisciplinary research environment. Past data analysts working in this role have earned co\-authorship on top scientific publications and are now enrolled in top PhD programs. Experience with R and Python preferred.
  
**Core Duties** :


* Collect, manage and clean datasets.
* Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data.
* Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical models, and perform statistical analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements.
* Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions.
* Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation.
* Analyze data processes in documentation.
* Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods.
* Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
* Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives.

**Minimum Education** :


Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.


**Minimum Experience** :


Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
* Strong writing and analytical skills.
* Ability to prioritize workload.

jobs.title: Environmental Professional (Scientist, Geologist, Engineer)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real\-world impact.


“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.


When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.


Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.


Our Project **Environmental Professional (Scientist, Geologist, Engineer)** position will support project work for a large oil/gas client located in Colorado centering around decommissioning, remediation, and regulatory compliance.


This position will have a combination of field/office and will have a strong regulatory compliance aspect. It is fast\-paced, technical in nature, and involves regulatory understanding.


The annual compensation range for this role is **$70,000 to $95,000** , commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.


To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities:


* Provide support to project management teams moving oil and gas sites through the decommissioning and remediation process towards regulatory closure.
* Prepare and manage regulatory reporting deliverables, including Colorado ECMC Form 27 Site Investigation and Remediation Workplans, ensuring technical accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Manage multiple project tasks simultaneously; serve as a field lead on select projects and mentor technicians and staff.
* Lead and support environmental field activities, including soil and groundwater sampling, subsurface investigations, and data collection.
* Oversee drilling subcontractors, maintain accurate boring logs, and support proper monitoring well design and installation.
* Apply relevant regulatory standards and technical guidance to project work.
* Track project hours and manage time effectively to meet scope, schedule, and budget expectations.
* Communicate proactively with project managers regarding schedule, budget, or technical challenges.
* Interface with clients to provide project updates and support client needs.
* Assist with cost proposal development and scope definition based on project requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to company policies and procedures.
* Follow company safety programs and OSHA regulations; participate in required safety training.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Your Expertise and Skills**

These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here.


* Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Environmental Science, Engineering or related field. Master’s a plus.
* 4–7\+ years of related environmental experience.
* Experience with soil and groundwater sampling and drilling oversight.
* Valid driver’s license; ability to pass background, MVR, and drug screening.
* 40‑hour OSHA HAZWOPER (current 8‑hour refresher).
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office / Google Suite; familiarity with AutoCAD, ArcGIS, or similar tools.
* Strong technical writing, analytical, organizational, and time‑management skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication; ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Ability to perform outdoor field work, lift up to 50 lbs., and travel locally with occasional overnight stays.

**Preferred**

* PG or PE license.
* Experience with groundwater fate and transport modeling.
* Familiarity with Colorado ECMC regulations.
* Form 19 and Form 27 Experience a plus.

\#INDONT


\#LI\-LK1


Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. For more information, visit www.onterris.com .


We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We acknowledge that these experiences and perspectives help to enrich our teams and contribute to our ongoing success. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our employment for all applicants. For US residents, click here to learn more.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist / Geologist
jobs.description:
**Senior Scientist / Geologist**  


Provide Technical Leadership. Drive Innovation. Solve Complex Environmental Challenges.  


**Pay:** Competitive and commensurate with experience  


**Position Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt  


**Location:** Office\-Based with Occasional Field Visits  


**Travel:** Minimal travel required  


**Reports To:** Project Manager  


**The Role**  


The **Senior Scientist / Geologist** serves as a senior technical leader within Tasman's Engineering \& Consulting group, providing expertise, guidance, and strategic direction across large projects, client programs, and cross\-functional teams.  


This role is responsible for defining technical approaches, reviewing complex environmental projects, supporting innovation initiatives, mentoring staff, and helping drive successful project execution. The ideal candidate is a highly experienced environmental professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while supporting the development of project teams and technical programs.  


As a trusted resource across the organization, this position influences project outcomes, technical standards, and long\-term business success.  


**What You'll Be Doing**  


**Technical Leadership \& Environmental Expertise**  


* Provide technical oversight and guidance on complex environmental projects and sites
* Review environmental investigations, remediation strategies, and corrective action approaches
* Evaluate and support implementation of innovative remedial technologies and solutions
* Serve as a technical resource for project teams, clients, and leadership
* Support company\-wide technical initiatives and best practices

**Project Support \& Technical Reviews**  


* Review and provide guidance on work plans, technical reports, and Corrective Action Plans (CAPs)
* Assist project teams with project scoping, planning, scheduling, and technical execution
* Support project managers in managing project risks, deliverables, and client expectations
* Help define project priorities and technical objectives
* Ensure technical consistency, quality, and regulatory compliance across projects

**Leadership, Mentorship \& Collaboration**  


* Mentor and train environmental scientists, geologists, engineers, and project staff
* Lead cross\-functional teams and coordinate technical resources across projects
* Foster accountability, ownership, and collaboration within project teams
* Support workforce development and technical growth initiatives
* Provide high\-level technical problem solving and decision support

**Strategic \& Organizational Support**  


* Contribute to development of technical standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Support innovation efforts and continuous improvement initiatives
* Influence technical direction for major projects and client programs
* Collaborate with engineering, construction, EHS, and project controls teams to achieve project objectives

**What You Bring**  


**Required**  


* Relevant technical diploma, bachelor's degree, or equivalent higher education in Environmental Science, Geology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in environmental consulting, engineering, remediation, or oil \& gas sectors
* Specialized knowledge of environmental investigation and remediation practices
* Demonstrated experience supporting projects of varying size, scope, and complexity
* Experience collaborating with EHS, engineering, construction, and project controls teams
* Advanced technical problem\-solving abilities
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent technical writing and document preparation skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive collaboration across teams
* Valid driver's license
* Authorization to work in the United States

**Preferred**  


* Advanced degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience working with environmental regulatory agencies
* Strong knowledge of environmental compliance and remediation programs
* Experience leading innovation initiatives and technical development efforts
* Professional registration or certifications relevant to environmental or engineering disciplines

**Work Environment**  


This role operates primarily in a professional office environment with occasional field responsibilities.  


**Office \& Field Conditions**  


* Primarily office\-based work supporting project teams and technical programs
* Occasional field visits for project reviews, evaluations, and technical support
* Exposure to varying weather conditions during site visits
* Potential exposure to environmental contaminants in controlled project settings
* Use of PPE and compliance with all safety requirements during field activities

**Physical Requirements**  


* Frequent computer and office\-based work
* Regular use of hands, fingers, and communication equipment
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching
* Ability to walk on uneven terrain during site visits
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 30 pounds

**Schedule**  


* Full\-time
* Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
* Occasional evening or weekend work based on project demands
* Flexibility to support client and project needs when required

**Required Education \& Experience**  


* Relevant technical diploma or university degree
* 8\+ years of experience in environmental consulting, engineering, remediation, or oil \& gas sectors
* Strong technical expertise in environmental practices and remediation methods
* Experience managing or supporting complex projects and technical programs

**Work Authorization**  


* Must be authorized to work in the United States
* Must possess a valid driver's license

**Benefits**  


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match (up to 4%)
* Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending

jobs.title: Intermediate Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
At Stantec, we approach every mining project we undertake—whether at the local, regional, or international level thoughtfully, and execute it with excellence across all project phases. We partner with our clients to design fit\-for\-purpose solutions that address their communities’ unique needs throughout the mining lifecycle. Our experts lead their fields and guide our work with technical excellence, an innovative spirit, and a vision for growth. We’re a place where you can apply your passion and collaborate with top talent on work that’s critical to our clients, our communities, and the industry at large.


Your Opportunity


Stantec is seeking qualified candidates for an Intermediate Level Hydrogeologist, reporting to an office in Salt Lake City, Reno, Denver or Phoenix (location is flexible). The primary focus of this position is to support hydrogeologic studies for our regional and international mining industry clients. The individual will engage complex projects related to industrial water supply, mine dewatering, acid rock drainage, metal leaching, mineral precipitation, pit lake chemistry, water\-rock interactions, and mine permitting.


The successful candidate will work on challenging, high\-impact projects within multi\-disciplinary teams to design and execute baseline studies, feasibility studies, and other hydrogeological investigations to support client objectives. Travel will be required and some projects require visiting remote sites.


Your Key Responsibilities


* Develop preliminary conceptual hydrogeological models to support field program design
* Design and oversee implementation of hydrogeology field investigations including drilling and logging of overburden and bedrock core, sampling of soil, groundwater and bedrock
* Design and oversee installation of monitoring wells, supply wells, dewatering wells, and vibrating wire piezometers
* Design and oversee single well and multi\-well aquifer test programs
* Support development of numerical groundwater models to support dewatering requirements and environmental impact assessments
* Prepare field data summary reports, including lithologic logs
* Travel as required to various field sites with overnight travel sometimes required (valid driver’s license is required)
* Follow safe work practices and adhere to company and client guidelines and policies for planning and executing work in a safe manner
* Strong communication skills and collaborative working relationships with cross‑disciplinary teams

Education and Experience


* A Bachelor’s degree in geology, hydrogeology or related discipline is required with a master’s degree preferred
* Experience using GIS tools
* Experience using hydrogeologic analytical tools for interpretation of aquifer test results
* Experience using groundwater modeling tools such as MODFLOW or FEFLOW preferred, but not required
* Minimum of 5 years of experience
* Strong technical writing skills
* Professional license (PG) or the ability to obtain a professional license
* Exceptional organizational, technical, written and oral communication and attention to detail skills
* Foreign language skills are a plus

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.


Stantec is a place where the best and brightest come to build on each other's talents, do exciting work, and make an impact on the world around us. Join us and redefine your personal best


**Pay Range:**


* Locations in CO, HI, IL, MD \& Various CA, NJ, VA Areas\-$80,300\.00 \- $116,500\.00 Annually


**Pay Transparency:** In compliance with pay transparency laws, pay ranges are provided for positions in locations where required. Please note, the final agreed upon compensation is based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. At Stantec certain roles are bonus eligible. Actual compensation for part\-time roles will be pro\-rated based on the agreed number of working hours per week.


**Benefits Summary:** Regular full\-time and part\-time employees (working at least 20 hours per week) have access to medical, dental, and vision plans, a wellness program, health saving accounts, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase program, life and accidental death \& dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance, short\-term/long\-term disability plans, emergency travel benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional membership fee coverage and paid family leave. Regular full\-time and part\-time employees will receive ten paid holidays in each calendar year. In addition, employees will be eligible to accrue vacation between 10 and 20 days per year and eligible for paid sick leave (and if more generous, in accordance with state and local law).


Temporary/casual employees have access to 401(k) plans, employee stock purchase program, and paid leave, in accordance with state and local law.


The benefits information listed above may not apply to union positions because benefits for such positions are governed by applicable collective bargaining agreements


**Primary Location:** United States \| CO \| Denver


**Other Locations:** United States \| AZ \| Phoenix
